title: Forge Hub | Autofarms, Fruit Sniper, Auto Dungeons & MORE
features:
🛠 Notice 🛠

This script is currently in beta. Updates and changes are expected. If you encounter any bugs, have questions, or would like to suggest new features, we’d love to hear from you.

Join our Discord server for support, bug reports, previews, suggestions, and more!

FEATURES:

AUTOFARM TAB
- Auto Farm (targets, method, hover above, hover height, ground distance, attack rate, auto equip best weapon)
- Auto Quest (quest NPC picker, auto repeat on complete)
- Auto Skill (skills picker: Z/X/C/V/F, per skill cooldown)
- Kill Aura (radius, tick rate, face target, hover above mobs)

COMBAT TAB
- Auto Boss Farm (boss picker, method, hover above, hover height, wait at spawn)
- Auto-Spawn (per boss toggle for each boss line)
- Auto Summon Boss (boss picker, summon cooldown)
- Auto Conqueror Haki (activation cooldown)
- Auto Use Items (item picker, use rate, use untradeable first)

DUNGEONS TAB
- Dungeon script (execute in dungeon, features listed below)

FRUIT SNIPER TAB
- Auto Snipe (match by name or rarity, target rarities/fruits list, snipe range, pickup hover time, return after snipe, notify on grab)
- Auto Eat Fruit (eat rarity filter, skip if fruit already equipped)
- Fruit ESP (rarity colour highlights, show rarity tag)
- Sniper status panel (fruits seen, fruits grabbed, last snipe)

PLAYER TAB
- Speed (slider)
- Jump (slider)
- Noclip
- Infinite Jump
- Anti-Slow
- Hitbox Extender (size slider)
- Auto Stat Allocate (stat priorities picker, points per second)
- Auto Reroll (systems picker, target rarity stop list, Discord webhook URL, webhook rarity filter, ping ID)
- Auto Equip On Spawn

TELEPORT TAB
- Island teleport (island picker)
- NPC teleport (full NPC list)
- Boss teleport (boss picker)
- Saved positions (save/load/teleport)

VISUAL TAB
- Mob ESP (distance, health bar, range)
- Boss ESP
- Player ESP
- Quest NPC ESP
- Service NPC ESP
- Fruit ESP
- Dungeon Portal ESP
- Hide Server UI
- FPS Boost

MISC TAB
- Anti-AFK
- Auto Claim Milestones
- Server hop / rejoin tools
- Redeem Codes
- Damage Counter toggle
- Stats Overlay (session kill/reroll/snipe/milestone tracker)

SETTINGS TAB
- Config save/load/auto-load on start
- Teleport speed + segment size
- UI scale
- UI toggle keybind
